additional_info.subject: ID0425192-DC/Si-D/NO-[MP / PN 170001140] Too many files open CRM:00315002656
additional_info.body:
Hi Simen,
As you reported
CFAST replaced and restored config. HMI is black after reboot. HMI looks normal during reboot, but when LED's turn on HMI goes dark and nothing happens. If we try a reboot the chargers goes in a boot loop and we have to reboot charger from USB again. We tried new HDMI cable, but HMI still dark
Before I escalate this, I would like to test the following:
Use the original CFAST and restore config
Bring a brand new CFAST
They will ask why are we using a refurbished CFAST which could have problems
​​​​​​​Bring a KF1 as well.
Test by order, first the original CFAST and restore config
If it works then you should probably send that refurbished CFAST back since it looks faulty
If it doesn't work
​​​​​​​Please try the brand new CFAST card
​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​If it works, then both CFAST cards are faulty
If it doesn't work, please replace KF1.
​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​Regarding the HMI, I'm not sure what to do here, when we had "Too many files open" did the screen work? If yes, then it should be PLC issue otherwise we might need to send a HMI too.
I will send this back to you.
Best regards,
​​​​​​​Francisco

additional_info.subject: RE: 0425192 - ID0425192-DC/Si-D/NO-[MP / PN 170001140] Too many files open CRM:00472000316
additional_info.body:
Hi!
We have tried to replace the Cfast card with to different cards. 2 cards (one of the original) we get different errors and not possible to boot.
Right now the charger is running and online with one of the new cards. But this specific card will only run with an dark HMI, charger works fine but HMI is dark.
We have also tried to replace the PLC, but this have not changed anything.
After last week we believe maybe the config file sent to me from SCB is for v6.1 but all the Cfast cards are flashed to v7, so that might be the issue?
I would like to check the config file and see if this is the case?
/Simen
